exploration.title: Effect-native OpenClaw Deployment Platform
openQuestions: Decision 7 reopened: can strict config ownership be OS-enforced (read-only boundary + independent drift audit) beyond the in-process OPENCLAW_NIX_MODE guard? Gate: filesystem bypass/drift prototype
Decision 6 refinement: separate workstation vs remote applicators (session/privilege/linger contracts) around shared renderers. Gate: non-interactive systemd --user apply prototype
Upgrade/rollback: generation state machine with SQLite snapshots vs auto-migrated user_version stamps. Gate: upgrade+failed-health rollback prototype
Secrets: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN bootstrap-credential exception (delivery, rotation, runbook) and same-ref rotation via secrets reload lifecycle. Gate: rotation/reload prototype
Decision 13 reshape: desired-intent schema + versioned render adapters + candidate-binary config-validate acceptance, instead of duplicating the plugin-dependent upstream contract
Solution-sketch reshape: introduce one OpenClawGeneration object binding package/config/unit/workspace/skills/plugins; skills are workspace mutations with a lockfile, not config fields
Channel-under-guard: render configWrites:false for the chosen DM channel and live-test login/pairing/migration writebacks under immutable mode
Decision 12 revisit (pre-dankserver): local Pulumi state + application state + sole operator workstation form one disaster domain; Command resources cannot reconstruct state via refresh
